name: HR Ontology
design_principles: Ontology names represent HR business meaning, not current CSV/Supabase column names.
Existing AI models/services keep their current canonical input contracts until later adapters are parity-tested.
Physical storage types do not define semantic data types.
Time-varying facts are modeled as records where practical rather than flattened into Employee.
Analytical outputs are separated from observed business facts.
Unconfirmed semantics are explicitly marked pending_confirmation and must not be normalized by guesswork.

modules.name: Compensation

modules.description: KPI definitions, evidence, normalized performance results, summaries, trends, and bands.

modules.name: Attendance & Workload

modules.name: Engagement & Employee Experience
modules.description: Engagement, satisfaction, work-life balance, manager relationship, and perceived career growth.

modules.name: Skills & Competencies
modules.description: Skill catalog, employee proficiency, position skill requirements, and skill gaps.

modules.name: Learning & Development
modules.description: Learning catalog, employee learning history, development and competency progression.

modules.name: Career & Mobility
modules.description: Experience, promotion recency, internal movements, transfer/promotion history, and mobility facts.

modules.name: Succession & Readiness

modules.name: Headcount, Position & Vacancy Planning
modules.description: Headcount snapshots, vacancies, recruitment state, workforce activity, and establishment planning.

modules.name: Workforce Cost & Budget
modules.description: Department and position people budgets, costs, variances, and utilization.

modules.name: Workforce Demand & Planning
modules.description: Demand drivers, expected staffing needs, scenario assumptions, and planning constraints.

modules.description: Rules, exceptions, thresholds, cases, severities, and recommended actions.

modules.name: AI / Analytical Outputs
